capex.item: Subsidiary PropEdge scaled its valuation business footprint to 245+ cities/towns/districts with 400+ employees and turned cash flow positive.
capex.quote: Our subsidiary PropEdge has continued its strong expansion, now present across 245+ cities/towns/districts with a team of over 400+ employees, and has turned cash flow positive during the year.

bull_bear.body:
- data moat: proprietary, on-the-ground primary research dataset — evidence: monthly updates on 195,000+ projects by 70,000+ developers across 55 cities, 18+ years of catalogued month-on-month data with 100+ data points per project unit
- customer lock-in: high client retention in subscription business — evidence: 80%+ client retention rate on the PE Plus platform
- distribution: integration with major bank websites for real estate data/lead generation — evidence: PropEquity builds, maintains and manages the back-end real estate data and websites for SBI Realty and ICICI Home Loans
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Failure to make required open-offer disclosure under SEBI SAST Regulations — The Secretarial Audit Report found that Mr. Samir Jasuja acquired more than 5% additional shares/voting rights during FY2025-26, despite already holding 25% or more of voting rights, without making the public announcement of an open offer required under SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011.
- Public shareholding fallen below minimum regulatory threshold — During FY2025-26 promoter shareholding exceeded 75%, causing public shareholding to fall below the minimum 25% required under Rule 19A(2) of the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Rules, 1957; the company is required to restore public shareholding to at least 25% within 12 months of the fall.
- Market adoption and demand-side uncertainty for the data-analytics platform — The company's future success depends on the growth and expansion of the market for tech-based real estate data analytics, which relies on client adoption, changing client needs, entry of competitive products and potential clients' willingness to invest in business improvements after prior investments in legacy systems; there is no guarantee organizations will pay for the company's services at all or at any particular revenue level.
- Macro and policy sensitivity of the real estate sector — Macro geo-political factors affecting India's GDP growth can influence new supply and sales-volume momentum in the short run, and rising mortgage rates are likely to impact end-user buying across cities.
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: PropEquity operates a subscription-based real estate business intelligence and analytics platform (PE Plus) covering residential and commercial real estate across 55 Indian cities, sold to developers, private equity funds, banks, NBFCs, HFCs, consultants, research houses and construction companies. It also offers Research & Consulting services (feasibility studies, market/consumer research, location and strategy advisory) and, through subsidiary PropEdge Valuations, real estate valuation, project monitoring and approved-project-finance services to banks, HFCs and NBFCs.

business.body:

- **Research and Consulting Services:** Location Advisory, Strategic Consulting, Development Consulting, Other Research Reports
- **Valuation Services:** Retail Valuation (Real Estate), Construction Finance Valuation, Project Monitoring (PMO), Approved Project Finance (APF)
- **AI / Technology:** PropEquity AI

deepdive.thesis: PropEquity (P. E. Analytics Limited) is India's largest real estate data & analytics business intelligence platform, serving developers, banks, NBFCs, PE funds and other institutions on a B2B subscription model.

open.item: Company is building and launching PropEquity AI, an AI-powered B2C chatbot intelligence platform for real estate, differentiated by proprietary data.
Company plans to reach a large share of developers across major Indian metros by end of March 2026.

Company signed a partnership with the University of Cambridge's Department of Land Economy to establish a Real Estate School and Centre of Excellence in Gurugram, aiming to launch its first programme by September 2027.
Company is scaling its CRM vertical by expanding capacity and enhancing capabilities to accelerate growth.
Company is building PropEquity AI, an AI-powered B2C intelligence chatbot platform for real estate, and taking it to the B2C market.
